# European Astrobiology Institute (EAI)

> > European consortium advancing astrobiology research, education, and training through international collaboration, conferences like BEACON 2025, and working groups studying planetary habitability, biosignatures, and origins of life.

The EAI brings together major European space agencies (CNRS, DLR, INAF, CNES) and research institutions to coordinate astrobiology efforts across Europe. The institute organizes biennial conferences, summer schools, streamed seminars, and maintains active project teams and working groups focused on Mars exploration, planetary environments, and the search for life beyond Earth.

## Key Topics

- Astrobiology research and education
- BEACON 2025 (Biennial European Astrobiology Conference)
- Planetary habitability and biosignatures
- Origins of life
- Mars exploration and Mars Sample Return
- European space agencies (DLR, CNRS, INAF, CNES, ESA)
- Summer schools and training programs
- Hydrothermal vents and extreme environments
- Exoplanet habitability
- Astrobiology and society
- Impact cratering and life evolution
- Early Earth and chemical evolution
- Working groups and project teams

## About the Institute

- [European Astrobiology Institute](https://europeanastrobiology.eu): EAI homepage: European consortium for astrobiology research & education
- [About EAI](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/about-the-eai): EAI mission, research areas: planetary systems, habitability, biosignatures
- [Participating Entities](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/participating-entities): 6 core orgs (CNRS, CNES, DLR, FNRS, INAF, CAB) & 22 institutions
- [Working Groups](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/working-groups): 6 scientific & 8 activity working groups: planetary systems, biosignatures
- [Project Teams](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/project-teams): 6 EAI project teams: astrobiology & art, Mars exploration, MSR, impacts

## BEACON 2025 Conference

- [BEACON 25 Homepage](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/beacon-25-homepage): Biennial European Astrobiology Conference, Reykjavik, July 1-5, 2025
- [BEACON 25 Programme](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/beacon-25-programme): BEACON 2025 programme: keynotes by Dick, Foucher, Heng, Tinetti & more
- [BEACON 25 Abstract Submission and Registration](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/beacon-25-abstract-submission-and-registration): BEACON 2025 registration & abstract submission, deadline May 31, 2025
- [BEACON 25 Practicals](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/beacon-25-practicals): BEACON 2025 practical info: Reykjavik travel, medical help, logistics

## Events and Education

- [EAI Events](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/eai-events): Summer schools, conferences: planetary evolution, early life, BEACON 2025
- [EAI Academy](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/eai-events/eai-academy): EAI Academy: online astrobiology seminars by CAB Madrid, 32+ countries
- [Streamed Seminars](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/streamed-seminars): Bi-monthly EAI seminars: photosynthesis, red dwarfs, Venus, biomarkers
- [Application – Traces of Early Life](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/application-traces-of-early-life): Apply for Traces of Early Life summer school, Stirling, June 3-13, 2025
- [Azores Summer School: Volcanism, Plate Tectonics, Hydrothermal Vents and Life](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/azores-ss-home): Azores 2023 summer school: volcanism, hydrothermal vents, lava caves, PCR
- [Summer School: Impacts and their Role in the Evolution of Life](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/summer-school-2023-homepage): 2023 summer school: impact craters & life evolution, Ries crater, Germany
- [Astrobiology and Society – Kiruna 2024](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/astrobiology-and-society-kiruna-2024): Social & ethical space exploration conference, Kiruna, Sept 23-25, 2024

## Research and Working Groups

- [Planetary Environments and Habitability](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/working-groups/planetary-environments-and-habitability): Working group led by Ana Catalina Plesa (DLR) on planetary habitability
- [European Astrobiology Campus](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/working-groups/european-astrobiology-campus): Working group led by Riho Motlep (U Tartu) on astrobiology education
- [Life Beyond Us](https://europeanastrobiology.eu/life-beyond-us): EAI & Laksa Media anthology: sci-fi stories & essays on alien life
